name: Sierra Leone
summary_text: Sierra Leone is dangerous for trans visitors. The 1861 Offences Against the Person Act criminalises buggery with up to life imprisonment (men only) — enforcement is limited but discrimination and violence are regular; no LGR; a small community organises quietly.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents Sierra Leone's criminalisation of same-sex activity (up to life imprisonment under the 1861 Offences Against the Person Act).

sources.title: Human rights in Sierra Leone Amnesty International
sources.claim_summary: Amnesty International Sierra Leone report 2025: freedom of expression threatened through cybersecurity libel provisions; new legislation protected women's and girls' rights but failed to criminalise FGM; general human-rights context, not trans-specific.

Joint ICCPR shadow report (March 2014) to the UN Human Rights Committee: 'Breaking the Silence on Human Rights Violations in Sierra Leone' - discrimination and violence based on SOGI; covers civil-war sexual violence, discrimination in health and education, hate speech by religious institutions, and hate crimes against LGBTI human-rights defenders.

US State Department 2012 Human Rights Report for Sierra Leone: documents police killings, corruption, FGM/C, and 'official and societal discrimination against lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) individuals'.

sources.title: Gay Sierra Leone News & Reports
sources.claim_summary: GlobalGayz archive of Sierra Leone news and reports: the rape and murder of lesbian activist FannyAnn Eddy (2004), her killer's escape, the government MSM study, and homophobic reactions to interviews - the Hirschfeld-Eddy Foundation is named partly in her memory.

sources.title: Over 80 Nations Support Statement at Human Rights Council on LGBT Rights - U.S. Mission to International Organizations in Geneva
sources.claim_summary: US Mission in Geneva (March 2011): post on LGBT rights in the UN context - US diplomatic advocacy for SOGI rights at the Human Rights Council, relevant to Sierra Leone's international human-rights environment.
